name: ai-content-manager
description: Automated AI Video Management & Editing Monorepo

scripts.dev:api: cd apps/api && (../../.venv/bin/python -m uvicorn main:app --reload --port 8000 || python3 -m uvicorn main:app --reload --port 8000 || python -m uvicorn main:app --reload --port 8000)
scripts.dev:worker: cd apps/worker && (nice -n 10 ../../.venv/bin/python -m celery -A celery_app.celery_app worker --loglevel=info --concurrency=1 -E || nice -n 10 python3 -m celery -A celery_app.celery_app worker --loglevel=info --concurrency=1 -E || nice -n 10 python -m celery -A celery_app.celery_app worker --loglevel=info --concurrency=1 -E)
